newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Bus, Karnataka authority in deal.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Bus, Karnataka authority in deal.

text.p: The bus division of Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of authority with the Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation on the production of bus bodies.
The aim was to develop passenger and environmentally friendly and cost-efficient public transport systems for Bangalore and other Indian cities, Volvo Bus said in a statement.

"In addition to the local production of Volvo chassis the intention is to establish a new factory for the production of bus bodies in cooperation with the Karnataka State Road Transport Coporation," it said.
The investment in the new bus plant is estimated to be 100 million crowns, it said.
Some 500 buses per year will be produced at the start of the project in Bangalore, it said.
The first step of the project is a joint feasibility study which will last from six to eight months, it said.
